description: Dead startup domains that are expired, expiring, parked, for sale, or abandoned -- sorted by estimated DR descending. These are acquisition candidates.

summary.tier3_abandoned_may_lapse: arrival.com, universalhydrogen.com, mindstrong.com, runningtide.com, zume.com, ubiquitousenergy.com, noogata.com

candidates.acquisition_strategy: BACKORDER NOW. clientRenewProhibited = domain will NOT auto-renew. Expiry Sept 21, 2026 + 45-75 day grace/redemption = potential drop Nov-Dec 2026. Was publicly traded EV company, massive press coverage from CNBC/Bloomberg/WSJ/Reuters = very high DR. Place backorder at GoDaddy, NameJet, SnapNames, and DropCatch immediately.
candidates.niche_value: EV/automotive - could build EV comparison tool, EV news site
candidates.risk_factors: Bankruptcy trustee may sell domain separately; could attract high auction competition
candidates.notes: Shows 'Under Maintenance' Next.js page. $1B+ raised, was on NASDAQ. Enormous backlink profile from 4+ years of public company coverage.

candidates.acquisition_strategy: NEGOTIATE PURCHASE. Domain registered through 2033 so won't drop. Contact domain holder via GoDaddy or former company representatives. As a dead news site with no ongoing operations, domain may be available for direct purchase.

candidates.risk_factors: Long registration = someone intends to hold. May want premium price.
